entries.dan: off-center ... one of my arms is cut off and there's space on the other side.
entries.measured: 133 px off centre -- the calibration point. Root cause: plan.js set one TALK_X = 0.478 for the whole video; Dan's measured torso centre wanders 0.411 -> 0.505, and a 9:16 window is 0.317 of the frame, so 0.06 of drift is ~200 px delivered.
entries.notes: A sibling build (v6-3min-home-workout/plan.js) had ALREADY found there is no single TALK_X, and the lesson was never carried back. /shortad-from-longform still has no framing rule at all.

entries.dan: substantially better than what we made. It looks better, it sounds better, and the graphics are better. Everything about his video is better than ours.
entries.measured: insert coverage 21% against his ~90%; longest bare stretch 64 s TWICE against Dan's own written 30 s rule; and the delivered file plays his voice out of the RIGHT SPEAKER ONLY with hiss on the left for all nine minutes (left channel SNR 0.4-1.0 dB).
entries.notes: This rejection produced qc_style.py -- which then reached exactly one skill. ⚠ The handoff's seed table says 'coverage 8.7 %'; the figure recorded at the time, and the one qc_style.py's MIN_COVERAGE comment cites, is 21%. 21% is what this entry asserts.

deliver._why: an organic YouTube long-form: graded against longform bounds, which is where qc_style's MIN_COVERAGE 0.40 and Dan's 30 s static rule live
